creator: Alexander Terp
description: `github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2` is imported directly (the Codex adapter renders custom agents with it) but go.mod still marks it `// indirect`. `go mod tidy` fixes that, and also moves `amterp/radish` and prunes unrelated go.sum lines, so it belongs in a commit of its own, checked with the full suite.
title: Run go mod tidy in its own commit
